summary: Iteration 3 (modular refactor + webhook signature validation + React.lazy code-splitting). All 32 backend pytest cases PASS (30 regression + 2 NEW dev-mode webhook tests). Webhook signature ENFORCEMENT path also manually verified end-to-end via curl: 401 with no/wrong Authorization, 200 with correct SHA256(testuser:testpass) hex AND 'SHA256 <hex>' prefixed form. Frontend lazy-loaded routes (/admin, /dashboard, /doctors/:id, /payment/status, /payment/simulate) all render correctly — route-loader Suspense fallback resolves cleanly, no stuck fallback. End-to-end: admin login -> CRM dashboard with 5 tabs clickable, user login -> BookingPage lazy-loaded with calendar+slots, Google btn -> auth.emergentagent.com.

issues: Email/password input fields and submit button lack data-testid attributes (only google-login-button has one). Tests had to fall back to type='email' / type='password' / type='submit' selectors. Minor.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Add data-testid='login-email-input', 'login-password-input', 'login-submit-button' to AuthPage.jsx login form fields for cleaner playwright targeting.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean — server.py shrunk from 833 to ~50 lines, domain logic split into core/, services/, routes/, seed.py with absolute imports. All endpoints behave identically (verified by running iteration_2's 30-test regression suite unchanged).

services/phonepe.py verify_webhook_auth() correctly accepts both raw hex and 'SHA256 <hex>' prefixed Authorization, performs case-insensitive comparison, and webhook_auth_required() gates enforcement only when both env vars are non-empty. Verified end-to-end via curl with both forms.

routes/payments.py webhook handler still always returns 200 OR 401 (auth fail) — it correctly raises 401 BEFORE the try/except, so PhonePe gets a hard rejection on bad signature instead of a silent 200. Good.
core/config.py centralizes all env-var reads (PHONEPE_*, JWT_SECRET, FRONTEND_URL, etc.) — no hardcoded values remain.
seed.py.ensure_indexes() runs on startup — ensures MongoDB indexes for users.email, doctors.specialization, appointments.user_id, transactions.merchant_order_id etc.

Frontend App.js wraps BookingPage, UserDashboard, AdminDashboard, PaymentStatus, PaymentSimulation in React.lazy + Suspense fallback (data-testid='route-loader'). All five lazy chunks load cleanly in <2s on the preview environment; no chunk-load errors observed in console.
PhonePe v2 OAuth integration still returns real mercury-uat.phonepe.com checkout URL (is_simulation=false) — verified by TestPayments::test_initiate_payment_real_phonepe_v2.
Note: existing iteration_2 callout that webhook lacked auth is now FIXED in iteration 3.
